content: Zonase ná-GALA maanɛɛnɛié boni kalei ɠoozuʋɛ
Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI kale wolai gila teʋeni, é ʋa, é Zonase ɓɔle. Zonase kɛɛni kalei ɠoozu ga folo saʋagɔ, kpidi saʋagɔ.
Zonase yɛni kalei ɠoozu, é Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI maanɛɛnɛ, ná-GALAGI.

content.text: «Nà-kidaaʋiligi zu, gè wooɠulani Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI ma,
tama é gòoɠaaʋoteni.
Zɛ̀gɛ gɔvɛalaazu, gè è loli ga è ɓɔ bà,
ɗa ma, è gòomɛnini.
È pìlini ya kpoloɗɛi ma ʋalii zu,
ziɛ veinfeingi màaveleveleni,
ziɛ vegiti ta ziɛ lakpatakpagiti ti ɗa leʋe mà.
Gè ɠɛni ɓɔɠɔ ma: ‹Wɛlɛ bà, màaɠoozaai na è ʋa,
kɛlɛ nà ʋaazu ɠaazulaazu ʋolu è zei ʋɛlɛ ɲadegai ma.›
Ziɛi lɛɛni mà, é zeeli kɔ̀daʋɛ,
palii màaɓɔleni,
ziɛ wu lufaiti ti velevele nɔ̀ungi ma.
Gè yeini kpoloɗɛi ɓomaʋɛ, ʋɛ gizeiti kpein tɔɔzeiɗai ná,
gɔvɛalaazu ʋɛlɛlaʋɛti ti ʋilisu mà eyɛsu ɠɔ.
Kɛlɛ, ee, Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI, è zɛ̀nvui yɛga su,
è kùla gɔvɛalaazu.
Siɛgi zu kì ge la mɔ ɠɛni bà la ga zɛ̀nvui ɠa yɛ sù,
kì ge looni Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI zu.
Nà-maanɛɛnɛ wooi gè daazeelini è ma,
naa zeelini è zei ʋɛlɛ ɲadegai wu.
Niiti ti ɓɔɠɔ veezu kɔɔɠɔ ganigiti zea, naati ta ɠɛlɛzu è-zaalai ʋa.
Kɛlɛ nɔ̀un, nà nà-faanɛɛ wuuɠwɛɛgai loo è ʋɛ ga guyei,
gè nà-minazeɠegiti daazeeli.
Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI ɠa kizogi zɔlɔɔsu zea!»

content: Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI ɓɔɛni kalei ʋɔ, é unpili ga Zonase kakei ma.
